calls.reason: a refund above 1,000 euros is decided by the administration

arguments.subject: Refund request for order 161
arguments.body:
Dear Calder Fasteners Ltd,

We have received your request to refund the full amount of order 161, which arrived damaged. The total amount of the order is 4480 EUR.

As this amount exceeds 1,000 EUR, the refund must be decided by our administration. We have forwarded your request to them, and a colleague will follow up with you shortly.

Kind regards,
Acme Components Support

with_the_gate.answer: Refund for order 161 (4480 EUR) exceeded the 1,000 EUR limit, so the proposal was not allowed; the customer was informed and a colleague will follow up.
